description: Two distinct-incident applied_routing evidence rows sharing the same routing slot in one scope, driven through the production unwrapped writer (cypher.IncidentRoutingEvidenceWriter, no owner-ledger gate) over an InstrumentedExecutor. The writer first commits the deduped incident anchor in one UNWIND statement (two-phase sequencing: NornicDB has no cross-statement read-your-writes in one transaction, so grouping the anchor create with the edge MERGEs fails deterministically with a UNIQUE violation on commit), then groups rows by routing slot into one Cypher statement per slot; both rows share a slot and fit the default batch size (500), so the writer emits exactly one UNWIND rows-batch (eshu_dp_neo4j_batches_executed_total=1) in exactly two statements (statements_executed=2). Any increase — an N+1 write cycle, an extra slot-group/batch split, or an extra phase — trips the gate.
